name: codex-supervisor
description: Codex Desktop wrapper for the durable Goal Mode substrate.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect durable Goal Mode recovery state from Codex Desktop.
interface.longDescription: Codex Supervisor exposes the compact MCP stdio server for read-only recovery and queue inspection over planning SQLite. Goal Mode owns judgment; work execution stays in the Python CLI and durable task, attempt, evidence, and acceptance model.
defaultPrompt: Show the Goal Mode recovery queue.
